description:
Implement the reusable most-reliable-basis candidate engine independently of generator-codeword and syndrome-error semantics.

## Background

The engine consumes canonical reliability permutations, ordered $\mathrm{GF}(2)$ elimination with right-hand-side transforms, and bounded Hamming-weight patterns. Semantic adapters supply the initial basis representation, candidate reconstruction, and validity rule.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Builds a most-reliable independent basis from the canonical permutation and ordered elimination result.
- [hard] REQ-02: Reprocesses order-$m$ test patterns through a caller-supplied semantic adapter and ranks candidates by deterministic soft metric with original-index tie behavior.
- [hard] REQ-03: Returns rank, theoretical cap, generated-pattern, tested-candidate, elimination, and termination metadata from `OsdConfig`.
- [hard] REQ-04: Handles rank deficiency, transformed right-hand-side inconsistency, cap exhaustion, and cancellation without a private eliminator or reliability sorter.
- [hard] REQ-05: Matches exhaustive bounded candidate search on small abstract fixtures for both supported semantic adapter shapes.
title: Shared OSD reprocessing engine
